name: Active View Selection and Residual Learning for 3DGS
definition: A framework combining residual learning (ResGS) and self-augmented pre-filtering (SA-HashGS/SA-Points) to improve active view selection and 3D reconstruction quality.
summary: SA-ResGS improves sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting by combining active view selection with residual learning, distinguished by its self-augmented pre-filtering mechanism that stabilizes view selection for reliable reconstruction.
